description: A pad whose path is drawn with the mouse, recorded, and played back as a pair of control voltages

params.text: Adds -5V to +5V to the X output
Adds -5V to +5V to the Y output
Plays the recorded path over and over as soon as the mouse is let go
Plays the recorded path from its own speed up to ten times faster
Multiplies the play speed by a larger step
Steps through built-in shapes, drawing a fresh random one each time
Draws a variation on the shape last made

inputs.text: A gate here plays the recorded path while it stays high, starting again on each new gate
A voltage here seeds the random number generator, so the same voltage always gives the same result from a randomise
A trigger here draws a fresh random shape
A trigger here draws a variation on the shape last made

outputs.text: Where the path is from side to side, -5V to +5V
Where the path is from top to bottom, -5V to +5V
Where the path is from side to side turned inside out, -5V to +5V
Where the path is from top to bottom turned inside out, -5V to +5V
10V while the mouse is held down on the pad, or while a recorded path is playing

notes: the outputs hold at one point until a path has been put on the pad: drag across the pad with the mouse to draw one, or press the shape button to have one drawn
menu: Forward Loop, Backward Loop, Forward One-Shot, Backward One-Shot, Forward-Backward Loop and Backward-Forward Loop — set how the recorded path is played back

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
